title: Open-Source Speech to Text: Inspect AI Dictation Before You Install
description:
Open-source speech to text is more than a GitHub badge. Inspect AI Dictation's client code, MIT license, build instructions, and offline/cloud boundaries before installing.

Official website: https://aidictation.com
Inspect the source: https://github.com/writingmate/aidictation

This does not imply that every dependency, model, or hosted service is MIT-licensed or self-hostable. Offline recognition availability varies by device and language; enabled cloud transcription or cleanup may send relevant audio or transcript text for remote processing.
